title: 145. Happy Number

examples.explanation: The sequence enters a cycle that does not contain 1.
1 is already 1, so its digit-square sequence stays at 1.

hints: Write a helper that computes the sum of the squares of an integer's digits.
A non-happy sequence must eventually repeat because digit-square sums are bounded.
Use a set to detect repetition, or use Floyd's slow-and-fast pointer cycle detection for constant extra space.
